description: This file defines an asynchronous grain class 'AsyncSimpleGrain' for a Orleans-based project, allowing asynchronous test operations such as setting and retrieving values, delaying execution for testing purposes.

classes.name: AsyncSimpleGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing asynchronous methods for setting and getting numerical values, extending 'SimpleGrain' and implementing 'ISimpleGrainWithAsyncMethods'.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and then returns the result of 'GetAxB()'.

methods.name: GetAxB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and then returns the result of 'GetAxB(a, b)'.

methods.name: SetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and sets the value of A to the provided integer.

methods.name: SetB_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and sets the value of B to the provided integer.

methods.name: IncrementA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and increments the value of A.

methods.name: GetA_Async
methods.description: Asynchronously delays for 1 second and retrieves the current value of A.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Creates a new TaskCompletionSource and returns its task.

methods.name: SetX
methods.description: Completes the resolver with the provided value of x.
